title: Entropy thresholds and circuit-breakers for kernel probing
creator: Asha Patel
description: Follow-up work from the Feb 14 latency spike where multiple inference workers entered a rapid speculative kernel reprobe phase after a sudden cross-tenant capacity surge. The probing amplified scheduling oscillation and increased p95/p99 latencies for short sequences. This ticket captures investigation notes, design constraints, and concrete mitigations to prevent recurrence.
timeline: 2026-02-14: Cross-tenant capacity surge at 03:12 UTC triggered speculative kernel probing. 03:13–03:22: Oscillation between quantized and unfused kernels observed; p95 latency rose from 82ms to 260ms. 03:25: Emergency rollback of recent scheduler heuristic (PR #8997) reduced reprobe rate. 2026-02-18: Post-incident synthesis meeting and repro harness created.
root_cause: A late change to the scheduler's confidence decay shortened the cooling period for kernel scoring, making entropy in kernel candidate scores spike when concurrency jumped. The runtime then aggressively reprobed alternative kernels across workers without a local circuit-breaker, causing batch fragmentation and KV cache churn.
mitigation_summary: Short-term: re-enable the previous cooling window and apply a temporary global probe-rate limiter (hotfix). Medium-term: introduce per-worker entropy scores, gating thresholds, and a local circuit-breaker that suppresses speculative reprobes when entropy exceeds a threshold. Add telemetry to track entropy, reprobe attempts, and circuit state. Long-term: integrate entropy-aware kernel ranking into compilation-time hints and incorporate canary tests in CI that simulate arrival bursts.
action_items: Implement per-worker entropy score (Metric: kernel_candidate_entropy) and expose in /metrics - owner: Liam O'Connor - estimate: 2
Add a local circuit-breaker that disables speculative reprobes for a worker when entropy > 0.7 for more than 5s - owner: Priya Desai - estimate: 3
Reintroduce configurable cooling_window (default 8s) and make it runtime-configurable via feature flag - owner: Mateo Ruiz - estimate: 1
Create an alert (pager) for sustained reprobe_rate > 50/minute per node and dashboard panel for entropy and reprobe_rate - owner: SRE (Ravi Singh) - estimate: 1
Add synthetic burst tests to the inference CI harness that validate p95 under a 5x short-burst concurrency profile - owner: QA (Emilia Chen) - estimate: 2
Author RFC for entropy-aware kernel ranking and land follow-up RFC with risk assessment and rollout plan - owner: Asha Patel - estimate: 3
Ship a canary rollout plan that gradually enables circuit-breaker on 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% of workers with rollback hooks - owner: Kevin Zhang (on-call) - estimate: 2
notes: Trade-offs considered: conservative entropy thresholds reduce false positives but delay recovery to better kernel; aggressive thresholds reduce latency but may miss beneficial reprobes. Proposed default is conservative; will tune with canary. Observability changes are highest priority to ensure the circuit-breaker itself doesn't mask regressions. Also need to ensure per-tenant fairness when circuit-breaker engages.
